notes.text: This is the production site, and logging in makes a real account on a waitlist. Never log in or sign up: type no email into the login dialog and don't continue with a wallet. Opening the dialog to see it and closing it again is fine.
Only what a visitor can do without logging in is tested here.
Market cards are not links and don't open a market page: clicking one opens the login dialog. Prices and % changes are live, so check that they are there, not what they say.
The category filter stays selected after the dialog is closed.

tests.name: Filter markets by category
tests.goal: A logged-out visitor filters the market list by category: Equity leaves only AAPL, NVDA and GOOGL, Commodity only Gold, Index only S&P 500 and NASDAQ 100, and All brings back all six, each with its leverage (20x for the indices, 10x for the rest), a price and a daily change.

steps.claim: The market list shows six markets: S&P 500, NASDAQ 100, Gold, AAPL, NVDA and GOOGL. Each card shows a leverage, a dollar price and a percent daily change; S&P 500 and NASDAQ 100 show 20x and the other four show 10x.
The market list shows only AAPL, NVDA and GOOGL, each with 10x leverage, a dollar price and a percent daily change. S&P 500, NASDAQ 100 and Gold are not listed.
The market list shows only Gold, with 10x leverage, a dollar price and a percent daily change. AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL, S&P 500 and NASDAQ 100 are not listed.

run.note: Filter market list by Index category

steps.claim: The market list shows only S&P 500 and NASDAQ 100, each with 20x leverage, a dollar price and a percent daily change. Gold, AAPL, NVDA and GOOGL are not listed.
The market list shows all six markets again: S&P 500 and NASDAQ 100 with 20x, and Gold, AAPL, NVDA and GOOGL with 10x, each with a dollar price and a percent daily change.
Gold is listed again
